scope: Two references for the W1 numerical methods fragment; not a full-paper reference audit

references.derivation: Simpson half-length h gives (2h)^5/2880. For two-point Gauss, gamma_2=8/45 on [-1,1], gamma_2/4!=1/135; affine interval scaling gives full-width^5/4320. Tensor extension uses positive weights and a sum of directional remainders.
